chunks: From him, from Mu'awiya ibn Hakim, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from 'Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur, who said:
I asked Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who comes to his wife in her rear (anus). He said: There is no objection to it.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, a title for Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.دُبُر: Rear, specifically referring to the anus in the context of marital relations
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: There is no objection to it; a phrase indicating permissibility or lack of prohibition

ai.seo_question: Is anal intercourse permissible in Shia Islam according to the Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani's chain in al-Istibsar establishes the permissibility of anal intercourse in marriage, a key point of discussion between Shia and Sunni jurists regarding whether it is merely permissible (mubah) or disliked (makruh). The phrase 'la ba'sa bihi' indicates general permissibility without explicit prohibition, reflecting the Shia view that the primary restriction is on the vaginal orifice, while the anus is a valid site for intercourse provided the woman consents.
